house_brick.name: Brick ranch house
house_brick.notes: One-storey brick house, dark shingle roof, 2-car garage, driveway. 67x22x104 studs.

house_purple.name: Two-storey lilac house
house_purple.notes: Lilac siding, dark roof, double garage, lawn and a small tree on its lot. 65x36x80.

house_green.name: Large sage-green house
house_green.notes: Big two-storey house with full interior; decimated to 12% (was 1.1M triangles). 91x46x96. Decimated to 12% (was 1.1M triangles, 67 MB; now 137k, 10 MB).

house_grey.name: Beige brick house with porch
house_grey.notes: Brick + beige siding, porch, garage, driveway. 97x38x107.

school.name: Brick school building
school.notes: Three-storey brick school, central entrance. Exterior only. 414x79x108 (very wide; use as a backdrop).

road_cross.name: 4-way intersection
road_cross.notes: 204x204 studs with sidewalks, crosswalks and traffic-light poles.

road_straight.name: Straight road with sidewalks
road_straight.notes: 40 wide x 50 long piece; tile it along Z for a street. Road top is at y=5.1 (thick slab): stand characters at y 5.1 on it; tiles every 50 along z.

streetlight.name: Street light
streetlight.notes: 21 studs tall pole with arm. Add a PointLight/SpotLight at the head for night.
